dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three to five prominent high-intensity 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-dorsal surface. These exhibit a sharp pixel-gradient transition from the low-intensity dark background to a high-intensity white/light-grey perimeter, forming irregular closed and semi-closed loops with a width of approximately 3-5 pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the anterior (head-ward) region. These clusters transition into more isolated, larger high-intensity nodes that define the boundaries of the macro-annuli toward the mid-body and posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle in the upper-mid section. These keypoints are connected by a series of smaller high-intensity blobs forming a roughly linear chain along the lateral-dorsal ridge.
